title: Good wine tasting
text: Good explanation about the wine and a fine host friendly and cozy. Great wines with good food. Highly recommended
author: Sjoerd_S

title: It was great to try some...
text: It was great to try some new grapes. Very nice wines and snacks in a quiet atmosphere. I would recommend this to anyone interested in learning about Spanish wine.
author: Michelle_B

title: Great experience!
text: Lovely wine tasting experience with a knowledgeable steward. He taught us about beautiful Spanish wines with tapas to accompany each selection.
author: Susan_F

title: Perfect experience and Oscar is the best!
text: If you’re going to do a Seville wine tasting this is the one to do! First all organic wine shop in Spain. Oscar was the best. My girlfriend and I had the best time with him. He knows his wine and was a great hang. He also provides a food pairing with each wine. I cannot recommend this experience enough!
author: joeyhX9181ZY
